lifecycle.notes: task_lifecycle.py owns every transition. The AI worker never edits this file. A task that burns through max_attempts becomes blocked instead of being retried forever.

autonomous_loop_policy.discovery_policy: research_cycle.py creates one scoped read-only investigation only when no eligible work exists. Concrete evidence-backed tasks always win. Completed findings, no-change outcomes and failed attempts inform rotation and cooldown; historic task rows are preserved.
